content:
Taking place on 3 March, next Friday, at Fórum Lisboa, the 1st BIM/GIS Workshop on Linear and Geotechnical Infrastructure, co-organised by members of BUILT COLAB.

This event is the first in a cycle of events dedicated exclusively to the BIM and GIS strands and their complementarity, and aims to address the challenges inherent in implementing these methodologies in Portugal and to share experiences in the digital transition process for linear and geotechnical infrastructure. It is being organised by GT3 of the Comissão Portuguesa de Geotecnia nos Transportes – Digitalisation in Transport Geotechnics (coordinated by BUILT COLAB) and GT4 of the Comissão Portuguesa de Túneis e do Espaço Subterrâneo, coordinated by the Sociedade Portuguesa de Geotecnia.

The programme includes the presentation of case studies by contracting authorities, designers and contractors, as well as software houses and teaching and research institutions.

The first day of the event is dedicated to sharing experiences in the design and implementation of the BIM methodology, in projects and works where the GIS component is decisive, as well as addressing future digitalisation challenges. The second day focuses on a visit to the Lisbon Metro works (to be confirmed).

Full event information and the registration link are available here.
